evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive issued as a settled operational instruction — the speaker expects compliance, not debate. Decision-grade commitment behind the instruction, but no identity-level permanence language to reach principle.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Same imperative register as src-1 — a flat operational command expecting compliance. Decision-level: settled and load-bearing, performed as a declarative instruction, but not identity-level bedrock.
